_README: Copy this file to .claude/settings.json and replace <COMFY> with your ComfyUI_windows_portable path. These rules let Claude Code run the project's stable-shape scripts (_gen.py, patch_thought.py, _rename.py, _translate_thoughts.py, _verify_translations.py, _dump_agent.py) without prompting. The deny rules block shell-based inspection of agents.json / session.json — Claude Code keeps reflexively reaching for `wc`, `python -c`, `powershell -Command (Get-Content ...)` etc. at wake time despite CLAUDE.md's explicit do-NOT list. The right tool for both files is the Read tool (they're plain JSON); these denies force that path. Paths must match exactly or prompts will reappear.
